           TANNICUM ACIDUM

         Tannin - Digallic Acid

        (TANNIC ACID)


Mostly used locally against excessive secretion of mucous membranes, to
        contract tissue and check hæmorrhage. In Osmidrosis, corrects fetor of the perspiration.
        Obstinate nervous coughs. Hæmaturia. Obstinate constipation. Pain in abdomen, sensitive to
        pressure. Intestines can be felt like cylindrical enlargements. One-half per cent solution.



Relationship.--  Gallic acid q. v.
